notes: DeepSeek Harness stores every current durable event as one physical JSONL row inside a checksummed Zstandard frame. The recipe requests the token large exactly 5000 times with single spaces, which is a deterministic 29999-character text payload. The transcript assertion requires that entire payload in one assistant/message text block and rejects tool calls, so a short response cannot satisfy only the lifecycle arc. The DSH adapter is single-birth: session.v3.jsonl.zstd exists at TUI launch under a stable session UUID. The shared tailer validates and decodes the frame, then applies readLineCapped with a 64 MB per-line limit. This live row is about 30 KB and is a sanity check, not a true cap stress. The same UUID session must complete ready to working to ready with no waiting transition. The exact driver model supplies non-zero usage and has no local price mapping.
